ability_experiment.design: Paired copies at the first legitimate ability checkpoint: force this ability versus skip that one reward; later choices random in both branches.

probability_review.formula: min(1,max(0,(pressure_after/limit)^exponent + spicy_stacks*0.15 - safety_stacks*0.15 - passive)); pressure_after>=limit or W overrides to 1
probability_review.roll: Fresh independent uniform roll per committed shake; previews never draw RNG. No hidden pity or boss bonus.
probability_review.caveat: Opponent reply examples use strength 1 and no defensive response; actual campaigns allow defense and other strengths.
